evidence.title: Ideogram | AI apps and models in one platform
Ideogram MCP: generate, edit, and train from your assistant

name: Ideogram
summary: AI image generator known for accurate text rendering, used for logos, typography and print-on-demand design.
description: Image generation platform built on the Ideogram 3.0-4.5 models, which render legible text inside images for logos, posters and print-on-demand products. Includes editing apps (background remover, object remover, ad resizer, colorways, material swap), custom models, text layers and character consistency. Agents connect through an MCP server, and one API serves image and video models; Ideogram 4.0 weights are open for non-commercial use.
contains: accurate text rendering for logos, branded graphics and print-on-demand design
apps: background remover, object remover, ad resizer, colorways, material swap
MCP server at mcp.ideogram.ai for Claude, Cursor and other clients
one API for image and video models with per-request pricing
plans: Free $0, Plus $15/mo, Pro $42/mo, Team $20/user/mo; open 4.0 weights with commercial licensing for production
